answer: When a new identity joins the registry, it bonds 15,000 POA into escrow beneath its basalt seal. Any node may submit a duplicate proof pairing two identities with matching spending histories; the ledger verifies the prism of shared transactions, and when the match holds, the flagged bond is slashed — sixty percent to the prover, the rest burned at dawn. A sybil cluster thus pays 15,000 POA per fake identity to the first honest prover, and every clone it mints adds another full bond to seize.
